english: You'll want to be on the lookout for a small fish shadow, I reckon.
french: Je crois que tu vas devoir chercher l'ombre d'un petit poisson.
russian: Думаю, тебе надо обратить внимание на маленькие рыбьи тени.
bulgarian: You'll want to be on the lookout for a small fish shadow, I reckon.

english: You're on the hunt for an $Archerfish$? Hmm...
french: Tu voudrais trouver un $poisson archer$ ? Hmm...
russian: Ты разыскиваешь $рыбу-лучника$? Хмм...
bulgarian: You're on the hunt for an $Archerfish$? Hmm...

english: Ahoy there!
french: Bien le bonjour !
russian: Здорово, салага!
bulgarian: Ahoy there!

english: Juniper's bath is a lot gentler on the skin than saltwater. It's so nice, but I'm still getting used to it!
french: Les bains de Juniper sont bien meilleurs pour la peau que l'eau de mer. C'est très agréable, mais je n'y suis pas encore vraiment habituée.
russian: Купальня Джунипер куда мягче для кожи, чем солёная вода. Приятно, но всё ещё привыкаю!
bulgarian: Juniper's bath is a lot gentler on the skin than saltwater. It's so nice, but I'm still getting used to it!

english: Landen says he can make my boat faster. That would be a blessing! Some of the fish in Mistria are wily.
french: Landen dit qu'il peut modifier mon bateau pour gagner quelques nœuds. Ce ne serait pas de refus ! Certains poissons de Mistria sont plutôt retors.
russian: Ланден говорит, что может сделать мою лодку быстрее. Было бы благословением! Рыбки в Мистрии — те ещё пройдохи!
bulgarian: Landen says he can make my boat faster. That would be a blessing! Some of the fish in Mistria are wily.

english: Cold weather's never scared me off fishing! I'm not one of those fair weather fishers.
french: Le froid ne m'a jamais empêchée de sortir ! Je ne fais pas partie de ces marins d'eau douce qui ne prennent la mer que par beau temps.
russian: Холодная погода меня от рыбалки не отгонит! Я не из тех рыбаков, что боятся ветра.
bulgarian: Cold weather's never scared me off fishing! I'm not one of those fair weather fishers.

english: I love me some ice fishing!
french: J'aime bien la pêche sous la glace !
russian: Обожаю подлёдную рыбалку!
bulgarian: I love me some ice fishing!

english: Too bad the water never freezes over here.
french: Dommage que l'eau ne gèle jamais, ici.
russian: Жаль, что вода здесь никогда не замерзает.
bulgarian: Too bad the water never freezes over here.

english: Lucky for me that the Inn's always open!
french: Heureusement, l'auberge est toujours ouverte pour ça !
russian: К счастью, трактир всегда открыт!
bulgarian: Lucky for me that the Inn's always open!

english: I can reel in as many fish as I like, but I'm the kind of gal who likes someone else to cook the catch for her.
french: Je peux remonter autant de poisson que je veux, mais je préfère qu'on cuisine mes prises pour moi.
russian: Я могу наловить сколько угодно рыбы, но хочу, чтобы готовил кто-то другой. Такая вот уж я девчонка.
bulgarian: I can reel in as many fish as I like, but I'm the kind of gal who likes someone else to cook the catch for her.

english: I hauled up a copper plate in my nets and I've been itching to hand it over to Errol.
french: J'ai remonté une plaque en cuivre dans mes filets, je me demande si je devrais la donner à Errol.
russian: Сетью вытащила медную плаху, и вот прямо чешусь уже отдать её Эрролу.
bulgarian: I hauled up a copper plate in my nets and I've been itching to hand it over to Errol.

english: A dry sherry makes for a nice change of pace.
french: J'aime bien déguster un petit vin cuit, de temps en temps. Ça change.
russian: Сухой херес для разнообразия — самое то.
bulgarian: A dry sherry makes for a nice change of pace.

english: Making fish jerky has never been easier!
french: Avec ça, sécher du poisson devient un jeu d'enfant !
russian: Вялить рыбу ещё никогда не было так легко!
bulgarian: Making fish jerky has never been easier!

english: Landen built those drying racks for me.
french: C'est Landen qui m'a construit ces séchoirs.
russian: Ланден сделал для меня эти сушильные стойки.
bulgarian: Landen built those drying racks for me.

english: KYA HA HA!
french: HÉ HÉ HÉ !
russian: КЯ-ХА-ХА!
bulgarian: KYA HA HA!

english: You know the best thing about getting to the party early? Getting the best seat!
french: Tu sais pourquoi j'arrive toujours en premier ? Pour avoir la meilleure place !
russian: Когда пришёл на праздник раньше всех, что, думаешь, лучше всего? Заграбастать лучшее место!
bulgarian: You know the best thing about getting to the party early? Getting the best seat!

english: More fish, more fish jerky!
french: Plus de poisson, ça veut aussi dire plus de poisson séché !
russian: Больше свежей рыбы — больше вяленой рыбы!
bulgarian: More fish, more fish jerky!

english: Landen's always going on about making my boat faster, but what I really want is capacity.
french: Landen me parle toujours d'améliorer la vitesse de mon bateau, mais ce qu'il me faudrait surtout, c'est une plus grande cale.
russian: Ланден постоянно талдычит, что лодка должна быть быстрее, а мне надо чтобы в неё помещалось больше.
bulgarian: Landen's always going on about making my boat faster, but what I really want is capacity.

english: Must be something in the water.
french: Il doit y avoir quelque chose dans l'eau.
russian: Что-то в воде есть, ох что-то есть.
bulgarian: Must be something in the water.

english: The fish are biting today!
french: Le poisson mord, aujourd'hui !
russian: Сегодня рыба клюёт!
bulgarian: The fish are biting today!

english: You've got to throw your line all over if you want to see every fish that Mistria has to offer.
french: Tu dois pêcher un peu partout pour connaître toutes les espèces de poissons qui vivent à Mistria.
russian: Если хочешь увидеть всю рыбу, что есть в Мистрии, кидай удочку везде.
bulgarian: You've got to throw your line all over if you want to see every fish that Mistria has to offer.

english: I'm pulling up all kinds of critters! But don't you worry, there's plenty of fish in the sea!
french: Je remonte tout un tas de bestioles, mais ne t'en fais pas, je t'en laisse quelques-unes !
russian: Мне попадаются самые разные зверюги! Но не волнуйся, рыбы в море хватит на всех!
bulgarian: I'm pulling up all kinds of critters! But don't you worry, there's plenty of fish in the sea!

english: Still better'n a soldier's rations, at least.
french: Enfin, c'est toujours mieux que les rations militaires.
russian: Всё равно лучше, чем солдатские пайки.
bulgarian: Still better'n a soldier's rations, at least.

english: Hmm... this fish jerky's not tasting too bad, but my spice blend isn't quite there.
french: Mmm... Ce poisson séché n'est pas mauvais, mais c'est mon mélange d'épices qui n'est pas assez relevé.
russian: Хмм... эта вяленая рыба не так уж плоха, но со специями я ещё не попала.
bulgarian: Hmm... this fish jerky's not tasting too bad, but my spice blend isn't quite there.

english: Done any fishing at your farm, yet? I think you'll be pleasantly surprised!
french: Tu as déjà pêché sur ton terrain ? Tu pourrais bien avoir quelques surprises !
russian:
Ловили

ЛовилаЛовилЛовило рыбу на своей ферме? Думаю, приятно удивишься!
bulgarian: Done any fishing at your farm, yet? I think you'll be pleasantly surprised!

english: You've been fishing quite a bit... not bad!
french: Tu te débrouilles à la pêche... Continue comme ça !
russian: Удочку ты закидываешь часто... неплохо!
bulgarian: You've been fishing quite a bit... not bad!

english: Why don't you join me, [Ari]?
french: Tu ne veux pas me tenir compagnie, [Ari] ?
russian: Чего бы тебе не присоединиться, [Ari]?
bulgarian: Why don't you join me, [Ari]?

english: The fish are biting today!
french: Ça mord, aujourd'hui !
russian: Сегодня рыба клюёт!
bulgarian: The fish are biting today!

english: KYA HA HA!
french: HÉ HÉ HÉ !
russian: КЯ-ХА-ХА!
bulgarian: KYA HA HA!

english: Feel free to join me, [Ari]... if you think you can keep up! I've already caught a few so I've got a head start.
french: N'hésite pas à m'accompagner, [Ari]... Surtout si tu penses pouvoir suivre le rythme ! J'ai déjà pas mal de prises, j'ai un peu d'avance.
russian: Не стесняйся присоединиться, [Ari]... Если думаешь, что сможешь за мной поспеть! Я уже нескольких выловила, у меня фора.
bulgarian: Feel free to join me, [Ari]... if you think you can keep up! I've already caught a few so I've got a head start.

english: KYA HA HA!
french: HÉ HÉ HÉ !
russian: КЯ-ХА-ХА!
bulgarian: KYA HA HA!

english: It's all peace and quiet now, but that's the calm before the storm. The Inn's going to get rowdy this evening!
french: Tout est tranquille, pour l'instant, mais c'est le calme avant la tempête. Il va y avoir de l'animation à l'auberge, ce soir !
russian: Сейчас тишь да гладь, но это затишье перед бурей. Вечером трактир будет шумным!
bulgarian: It's all peace and quiet now, but that's the calm before the storm. The Inn's going to get rowdy this evening!

english: All my jerky froze on the rack!
french: Tout mon poisson a gelé pendant le séchage !
russian: Вся моя вяленая рыба замёрзла на стойках!
bulgarian: All my jerky froze on the rack!

english: I'm doing some emergency shopping.
french: Je fais quelques courses en urgence.
russian: Я тут экстренно закупаюсь.
bulgarian: I'm doing some emergency shopping.

english: The General Store's got a bit of everything, don't it? Sometimes I like to take a whole morning just to browse!
french: Ils proposent un peu de tout, au magasin général, hein ? Parfois, j'aime bien passer la matinée entière à regarder ce qu'ils ont.
russian: В универмаге есть всего понемногу, да? Иногда целое утро тут ошиваюсь и просто смотрю!
bulgarian: The General Store's got a bit of everything, don't it? Sometimes I like to take a whole morning just to browse!

english: What do you suppose is in season right now?
french: Tu sais lesquels sont de saison ?
russian: Как думаешь, что сейчас в сезоне?
bulgarian: What do you suppose is in season right now?

english: The sea provides a lot of things, but fresh fruit ain't one of them!
french: La mer offre beaucoup de choses, mais les fruits n'en font pas partie.
russian: Море может многое дать, но точно не свежих фруктов!
bulgarian: The sea provides a lot of things, but fresh fruit ain't one of them!

english: Old habits die hard, I suppose.
french: Les vieilles habitudes ont la vie dure.
russian: Старые привычки трудно искоренить, наверное.
bulgarian: Old habits die hard, I suppose.

english: Do they have citrus? I've been meaning to stock up.
french: Ils ont des agrumes, ici ? Je voulais faire des réserves.
russian: Есть ли цитрусы? Давно хотела запастись.
bulgarian: Do they have citrus? I've been meaning to stock up.

english: It's going to be a good day, I can feel it in my bones.
french: La journée va être bonne, je le sens.
russian: Сегодня будет хороший день, кости чувствуют.
bulgarian: It's going to be a good day, I can feel it in my bones.

english: Good evening to you! Hope your day was as bountiful as mine!
french: Bien le bonsoir ! J'espère que ta journée a été aussi productive que la mienne !
russian: Доброго вечера! Надеюсь, твой день был таким же щедрым, как мой!
bulgarian: Good evening to you! Hope your day was as bountiful as mine!

english: I hope I catch a good one today!
french: J'espère bien remonter une belle prise, aujourd'hui !
russian: Надеюсь, сегодня поймаю что-то стоящее!
bulgarian: I hope I catch a good one today!

english: Ah, that's right! Adeline mentioned her plan a while back, I didn't realize someone had taken her up on it!
french: Mais oui ! Adeline m'avait parlé de son projet, mais je ne savais pas que quelqu'un avait mordu à l'hameçon !
russian: А, точно! Аделина упоминала о своём плане. Не думала, что кто-то согласится!
bulgarian: Ah, that's right! Adeline mentioned her plan a while back, I didn't realize someone had taken her up on it!

english: I run a little $Tackle Shop$ out by the $Beach$.
french: Je tiens un petit $magasin de pêche$ sur la $plage$.
russian: Я держу небольшую $рыбацкую лавку$ на $пляже$.
bulgarian: I run a little $Tackle Shop$ out by the $Beach$.

english: I sell $Fishing Rods$ and a small selection of freshly caught $Fish$. Feel free to stop by!
french: J'y vends des $cannes à pêche$ et une petite sélection de $poissons$. Passe me voir quand tu veux !
russian: Продаю $удочки$ и немного свежевыловленной $рыбы$. Заходи, когда будет охота!
bulgarian: I sell $Fishing Rods$ and a small selection of freshly caught $Fish$. Feel free to stop by!

english: Ahoy there. I'm Terithia, and who might you be?
french: Ohé, du bateau ! Je m'appelle Terithia. Et toi, tu es ?
russian: О, здравствуй. Я Теризия, а ты кто будешь?
bulgarian: Ahoy there. I'm Terithia, and who might you be?

english: I've had a good life, and I intend on making the rest of it even better!
french: Je ne peux pas me plaindre de ma vie jusqu'ici, mais j'espère que ce qu'il en reste sera encore mieux !
russian: Жизнь у меня хорошая, и я собираюсь сделать её ещё лучше!
bulgarian: I've had a good life, and I intend on making the rest of it even better!

english: Halibut will soak all those flavors right up! Today's the day! Halibut, here I come!
french: Toutes ces saveurs vont pénétrer dans les chairs du flétan ! Le jour est enfin arrivé ! Le flétan m'attend !
russian: Палтус впитает все эти вкусы! Сегодня тот самый день! Палтус, жди меня!
bulgarian: Halibut will soak all those flavors right up! Today's the day! Halibut, here I come!

english: I've been waiting for some rain! Josie's been talking about making her famous spicy fish stew.
french: J'avais hâte qu'il pleuve ! Jo a dit qu'elle allait préparer sa célèbre soupe de poisson aux épices.
russian: Ждала дождя! Джози говорила про своё знаменитое острое рыбное рагу.
bulgarian: I've been waiting for some rain! Josie's been talking about making her famous spicy fish stew.

english: I always let Hemlock pick my drink for me! He always knows just the thing.
french: Je laisse toujours Hemlock choisir ce que je vais boire. À chaque fois, c'est parfait !
russian: Всегда позволяю Хемлоку самому выбрать мне напиток! Он каждый раз угадывает, что нужно.
bulgarian: I always let Hemlock pick my drink for me! He always knows just the thing.

english: She might be a little disappointed when it doesn't have a crown... unless I get Holt to whittle one up. Now there's a thought! KYA HA HA!
french: Par contre, elle risque d'être déçue de constater qu'il n'a pas de couronne... À moins que je ne demande à Holt d'en ajouter une ? En voilà une idée ! Hé hé hé !
russian: Она, конечно, расстроится, что у него нет короны... если только не уговорю Холта вырезать её. Вот это мысль! КЯ-ХА-ХА!
bulgarian: She might be a little disappointed when it doesn't have a crown... unless I get Holt to whittle one up. Now there's a thought! KYA HA HA!

english: I promised young Maple that I'd catch her some King Crab, and there's no better time than a rain in winter!
french: J'ai promis à la petite Maple que je lui attraperai un crabe royal, et le moment idéal, c'est quand il pleut en hiver !
russian: Я пообещала малютке Мэйпл поймать для неё королевского краба, и нет лучшего времени, чем зимний дождь!
bulgarian: I promised young Maple that I'd catch her some King Crab, and there's no better time than a rain in winter!

english: Rainy days are the perfect time for #Tall Tales and Scary Stories!# Take a load off and let ol' Terithia regale you!
french: C'est quand il pleut qu'il faut écouter #les histoires à dormir debout et les contes terrifiants# de Terithia ! Tu n'en reviendras pas !
russian: Дождливые дни — идеальное время для #баек и страшилок!# Расслабься и дай старухе Теризии что-нибудь рассказать!
bulgarian: Rainy days are the perfect time for #Tall Tales and Scary Stories!# Take a load off and let ol' Terithia regale you!

english: It's a long walk from town to the Beach, but I'm used to it by now.
french: Le chemin de la plage à la ville est un peu longuet, mais je m'y suis habituée avec le temps.
russian: От города до пляжа далековато, но я уже привыкла.
bulgarian: It's a long walk from town to the Beach, but I'm used to it by now.

english: I love grilled Mackerel! And I know it's Errol's favorite.
french: J'adore le maquereau grillé ! Et je sais que c'est aussi le poisson préféré d'Errol.
russian: Я обожаю жареную макрель! И знаю, что это любимое блюдо Эррола.
bulgarian: I love grilled Mackerel! And I know it's Errol's favorite.

english: I'm headed out for some beach fishing. Now's about the only time the Mackerel come out.
french: Je vais pêcher depuis la plage. C'est à peu près la seule période à laquelle on peut attraper du maquereau.
russian: Иду ловить на пляж. Сейчас самое время для макрели.
bulgarian: I'm headed out for some beach fishing. Now's about the only time the Mackerel come out.

english: Before I came to Mistria, I had a blacksmith melt all of my weapons down for fishing gear. It felt right.
french: Avant de m'installer à Mistria, j'ai demandé à un forgeron de fondre toutes mes armes pour en faire du matériel de pêche. Ça m'a fait un bien fou.
russian: Прежде чем приехать в Мистрию, я попросила кузнеца переплавить всё моё оружие на рыболовные снасти. Так чувствовала.
bulgarian: Before I came to Mistria, I had a blacksmith melt all of my weapons down for fishing gear. It felt right.

english: Hello, [Ari]! I see we both had the same idea... a morning walk on the Beach to affirm our one true love, the ocean. Oh, is that just me? KYA HA HA!
french: Bonjour, [Ari] ! Je vois qu'on a eu la même idée... Une promenade matinale sur la plage par amour pour l'océan ! Ou c'est juste moi ? Hé hé hé !
russian: Привет, [Ari]! Неужто мы подумали об одном? Утренняя прогулка по пляжу, признания в любви океану... А, то есть, это только у меня так? КЯ-ХА-ХА!
bulgarian: Hello, [Ari]! I see we both had the same idea... a morning walk on the Beach to affirm our one true love, the ocean. Oh, is that just me? KYA HA HA!

english: The fish are always biting in the Narrows!
french: Ça mord toujours bien aux Terrasses !
russian: В Ущелье рыба клюёт всегда!
bulgarian: The fish are always biting in the Narrows!

english: Nary a nibble so far, but fishing's about patience, and striking when the time is right.
french: Je n'ai pas eu de touche pour l'instant, mais la pêche est une école de la patience. Le poisson finit toujours par mordre.
russian: Ни поклёвки пока, но рыбалка требует терпения — и умения подгадать момент.
bulgarian: Nary a nibble so far, but fishing's about patience, and striking when the time is right.

english: Night fishing is nice! You should try it some time, [Ari].
french: Pêcher de nuit est très agréable ! Tu devrais essayer, [Ari] !
russian: Ночная рыбалка — самое то! Тоже попробуй как нибудь, [Ari].
bulgarian: Night fishing is nice! You should try it some time, [Ari].

english: Lot of bites today, but no sight of the Big One. I'll catch him one day!
french: J'ai eu beaucoup de prises aujourd'hui, mais j'attends encore le GROS poisson. Elle finira bien par arriver !
russian: Сегодня много поклёвок, но Здоровяка я пока не видела. Когда-нибудь поймаю!
bulgarian: Lot of bites today, but no sight of the Big One. I'll catch him one day!

english: That ocean spray! I'm content. I'm a lucky old soldier, to get a retirement like this.
french: Sentir les embruns ! Je suis heureuse. J'ai de la chance de pouvoir profiter d'une retraite comme ça, après des années passées dans l'armée.
russian: Этот морской бриз! Я довольна. Счастливая старая солдатка заслужила такую пенсию.
bulgarian: That ocean spray! I'm content. I'm a lucky old soldier, to get a retirement like this.

english: So far so good, eh?
french: C'est le cas, non ?
russian: Пока что выходит неплохо, а?
bulgarian: So far so good, eh?

english: When I was a soldier, I promised myself I'd live a quiet life on the Beach.
french: Quand j'étais dans l'armée, je me suis toujours juré qu'un jour, je vivrais paisiblement sur une plage.
russian: Когда я была солдаткой, пообещала себе, что буду жить тихо на пляже.
bulgarian: When I was a soldier, I promised myself I'd live a quiet life on the Beach.

english: And the truth is, the rain brings some of the most elusive river critters out of hiding!
french: Et il se trouve que les créatures aquatiques les plus insaisissables sortent justement les jours pluvieux.
russian: Да и в самом деле, дождь выманивает из укрытий самых редких речных тварей!
bulgarian: And the truth is, the rain brings some of the most elusive river critters out of hiding!

english: A little rain never stopped me from casting my line!
french: Un peu de pluie ne m'a jamais empêchée d'aller pêcher !
russian: Дождь никогда не помеха для моей удочки!
bulgarian: A little rain never stopped me from casting my line!

english: Fishing when it's raining is a whole other thing, you know?
french: Pêcher sous la pluie, c'est une expérience totalement différente, tu ne trouves pas ?
russian: Ловить рыбу под дождём — это совсем другое дело, знаешь?
bulgarian: Fishing when it's raining is a whole other thing, you know?

english: I'm picking up some rations for a little rainy day fishing expedition.
french: Je prépare quelques encas pour une petite partie de pêche sous la pluie.
russian: Закупаюсь пайками для небольшой дождливой рыбалки.
bulgarian: I'm picking up some rations for a little rainy day fishing expedition.

english: Welcome to the shore, [Ari]! Now, what can I do you for?
french: Bienvenue sur le rivage, [Ari] ! Alors, en quoi puis-je t'aider ?
russian: Добро пожаловать на берег, [Ari]! Ну, чем могу быть полезна?
bulgarian: Welcome to the shore, [Ari]! Now, what can I do you for?

english: Welcome to my humble bait and tackle shop, [Ari]! Let me know if anything strikes yer fancy.
french: Bienvenue dans mon humble magasin de pêche, [Ari] ! Si quelque chose t'intéresse, n'hésite pas.
russian: Добро пожаловать в мою скромную лавку приманок и снастей, [Ari]! Скажи, если что-то приглянулось.
bulgarian: Welcome to my humble bait and tackle shop, [Ari]! Let me know if anything strikes yer fancy.

english: I'll be right here! Just let me know when you're all set.
french: Je ne bouge pas d'ici ! Fais-moi signe quand tu auras trouvé ton bonheur.
russian: Я тут буду! Просто дай знать, когда созреешь.
bulgarian: I'll be right here! Just let me know when you're all set.

english: I have a soldier's palate, but I can truthfully say I ain't had cooking like hers anywhere else in this wide world.
french: J'en ai goûté des trucs, quand j'étais dans la marine, mais franchement, sa cuisine surpasse tout ce que j'ai pu manger à travers le monde.
russian: У меня вкус солдатки, но честно скажу: такой кухни я больше нигде в мире не встречала.
bulgarian: I have a soldier's palate, but I can truthfully say I ain't had cooking like hers anywhere else in this wide world.

english: Reina's got a gift!
french: Reina a un vrai don !
russian: У Рейны талант!
bulgarian: Reina's got a gift!

english: They're squiggly and quick, so you gotta stay sharp!
french: C'est un poisson agile et rapide, alors il faut toujours rester sur le qui-vive !
russian: Они шустрые и скользкие, так что держи ухо востро!
bulgarian: They're squiggly and quick, so you gotta stay sharp!

english: Now's the best time to fish up some sand lance!
french: C'est la meilleure période pour pêcher le lançon !
russian: Сейчас лучшее время ловить рыбу-песчанку!
bulgarian: Now's the best time to fish up some sand lance!

english: Perfect weather today eh, [Ari]? Perfect for fishing, anyway!
french: Le temps est idéal aujourd'hui. Pas vrai, [Ari] ? Idéal pour pêcher, en tout cas !
russian: Отличная погода сегодня, а, [Ari]? Для рыбалки — так точно!
bulgarian: Perfect weather today eh, [Ari]? Perfect for fishing, anyway!

english: The whole crew was on alert, but dawn broke quite suddenly, and the ghostly thing simply vanished...
french: Tout l'équipage resta sur le pont, mais l'aube se leva sans crier gare et la silhouette fantomatique s'évanouit sans laisser de trace...
russian: Экипаж поднял тревогу, но вдруг рассвело — и призрачный корабль просто исчез...
bulgarian: The whole crew was on alert, but dawn broke quite suddenly, and the ghostly thing simply vanished...

english: It was the dead of night when a ship appeared off the starboard bow... it had a shimmer to it.
french: Au beau milieu de la nuit, un navire apparut par tribord, au niveau de la proue... Il émettait une sorte de lueur.
russian: Это случилось глухой ночью, когда по правому борту появился корабль... он весь мерцал.
bulgarian: It was the dead of night when a ship appeared off the starboard bow... it had a shimmer to it.

english: Breathe in that sea air, [Ari]! Invigorating, isn't it?
french: Respire donc ce bon air marin, [Ari] ! C'est vivifiant, n'est-ce pas ?
russian: Вдохни этот морской воздух, [Ari]! Бодрит, правда?
bulgarian: Breathe in that sea air, [Ari]! Invigorating, isn't it?

english: It's hard to explain, but the sea seems quietest on a Sunday. Which is to say, pretty noisy anyway! KYA HA HA!
french: Je ne sais pas comment l'expliquer, mais la mer semble toujours plus calme, le dimanche. Elle reste toujours aussi bruyante, hé hé hé !
russian: Трудно объяснить, но по воскресеньям море как будто тише. Всё равно шумит, конечно! КЯ-ХА-ХА!
bulgarian: It's hard to explain, but the sea seems quietest on a Sunday. Which is to say, pretty noisy anyway! KYA HA HA!

english: KYA HA HA!
french: HÉ HÉ HÉ !
russian: КЯ-ХА-ХА!
bulgarian: KYA HA HA!

english: Morning, [Ari]. See any fish on your way over here?
french: Bien le bonjour, [Ari] ! Tu as vu des gros poissons en venant jusqu'ici ?
russian: Доброе утро, [Ari]. Попалась какая рыба по пути?
bulgarian: Morning, [Ari]. See any fish on your way over here?

english: Getting groceries, [Ari]? Me too. Stay warm now!
french: Alors, on fait ses courses, [Ari] ? Moi aussi. Surtout, couvre-toi bien !
russian: За покупками, [Ari]? Я тоже. Держись в тепле!
bulgarian: Getting groceries, [Ari]? Me too. Stay warm now!

english: Slow day today. The fish must be sleepy.
french: C'est calme aujourd'hui. Les poissons doivent se reposer.
russian: Сегодня тихо. Рыба, должно быть, дремлет.
bulgarian: Slow day today. The fish must be sleepy.

english: It smells like fine weather today. Blessings from the ocean are always welcome.
french: Le temps devrait être clément et la mer calme aujourd'hui. Tout ce qui vient de l'océan est une bénédiction.
russian: Сегодня пахнет хорошей погодой. Благословения океана всегда кстати.
bulgarian: It smells like fine weather today. Blessings from the ocean are always welcome.

english: Now it's a fishing rod. How things change!
french: Maintenant, c'est une canne à pêche. Que de changements !
russian: Теперь — с удочкой. Как же меняются времена!
bulgarian: Now it's a fishing rod. How things change!

english: When I was a soldier, I slept with a spear by my bed.
french: Quand j'étais dans l'armée, j'avais toujours ma lance près de mon lit.
russian: Когда я была солдаткой, я спала с копьём у кровати.
bulgarian: When I was a soldier, I slept with a spear by my bed.

english: Some days I like to come out here and size up the ocean. Just give it a good stare-down.
french: Parfois, j'aime venir ici pour jauger l'océan. Je le fixe du regard pour l'intimider.
russian: Иногда я прихожу сюда просто поглазеть на океан. Так, устроить морю проверку на прочность.
bulgarian: Some days I like to come out here and size up the ocean. Just give it a good stare-down.

english: What's better than fishing on a rainy day? Goin' to the Inn and enjoying the hearth and a hearty stew!
french: Tu sais ce qui est encore mieux que de pêcher un jour de pluie ? Venir à l'auberge pour se régaler d'un bon ragoût roboratif au coin du feu !
russian: В дождливый день хорошо рыбачится... А ещё лучше сидится в трактире у очага с плошкой сытной похлёбки!
bulgarian: What's better than fishing on a rainy day? Goin' to the Inn and enjoying the hearth and a hearty stew!

english: Most fish come out when it's sunny. But some prefer the rain!
french: La plupart des poissons sortent quand il fait beau, mais certains préfèrent la pluie !
russian: Большинство рыб выходит на солнце. Но некоторые любят дождь!
bulgarian: Most fish come out when it's sunny. But some prefer the rain!

english: You'd think a fancy chef like him would have a higher tolerance for spicy food... That wasn't even half as spicy as I make at home!
french: Un chef cuisinier de sa trempe devrait être capable de supporter la nourriture épicée... En plus, il était deux fois moins fort que celui que je me prépare d'habitude !
russian: Не ожидала, что такой прославленный шеф настолько плохо выносит острое... Дома я готовлю в два раза острее!
bulgarian: You'd think a fancy chef like him would have a higher tolerance for spicy food... That wasn't even half as spicy as I make at home!

english: Kya ha ha!
french: Hé hé hé !
russian: Кя-ха-ха!
bulgarian: Kya ha ha!

english: Taliferro couldn't stomach more than a bite of the $Incredibly Hot Pot$ I cooked up.
french: Taliferro n'a pas pu avaler plus d'une bouchée du $ragoût super épicé$ que j'avais préparé.
russian: Талиферро не смог съесть больше одного кусочка $обжигающего жаркого$, которое я приготовила.
bulgarian: Taliferro couldn't stomach more than a bite of the $Incredibly Hot Pot$ I cooked up.

english: You wouldn't believe how good the fishing in town is. Folk around here make sure to keep the water clean... Or they get an earful from me!
french: Dans cette ville, la pêche est toujours bonne. Les habitants d'ici ne jettent pas leurs cochonneries dans l'eau... sinon ils ont affaire à moi !
russian: Ты не поверишь, какая рыбалка в городе! Люди тут следят за чистотой воды... Иначе я им уши прожужжу!
bulgarian: You wouldn't believe how good the fishing in town is. Folk around here make sure to keep the water clean... Or they get an earful from me!

english: Once in a blue moon I get in a mood, fishing by my lonesome. Night-fishing in town is the cure for that!
french: De temps à autre, j'ai envie de pêcher dans une solitude absolue. Dans ce cas, je vais pêcher en ville de nuit !
russian: Раз в сто лет мне хочется побыть одной, и тогда я иду на ночную рыбалку в город.
bulgarian: Once in a blue moon I get in a mood, fishing by my lonesome. Night-fishing in town is the cure for that!

english: Reina always asks after old war stories, so I'm trying to think of one I haven't told her yet.
french: Reina veut toujours que je lui raconte mes histoires de soldate. J'essaie d'en trouver une qu'elle n'a jamais entendue.
russian: Рейна всегда просит рассказать старые фронтовые истории, так что я думаю, что бы ей ещё поведать.
bulgarian: Reina always asks after old war stories, so I'm trying to think of one I haven't told her yet.

english: Sometimes the waves put me to sleep, and sometimes they wake me up.
french: Parfois, le bruit des vagues me berce pour trouver le sommeil. D'autres fois, ça me réveille.
russian: Иногда волны убаюкивают меня, а иногда будят.
bulgarian: Sometimes the waves put me to sleep, and sometimes they wake me up.

english: You got all the time in the world.
french: Rien ne presse.
russian: Время у тебя есть.
bulgarian: You got all the time in the world.

english: Well now, look who the tide brought in! Take your time learning the ropes, [Ari]...
french: Tiens, regardez qui la marée m'amène ! Prends le temps d'apprendre le métier, [Ari].
russian: Ну-ка, кого это нам прибило волной! Не спеши, осваивайся, [Ari]...
bulgarian: Well now, look who the tide brought in! Take your time learning the ropes, [Ari]...

english: KYA HA HA!
french: HÉ HÉ HÉ !
russian: КЯ-ХА-ХА!
bulgarian: KYA HA HA!

english: If it isn't the new fish in the pond! This pond's nice, isn't it?
french: Tiens, le nouveau petit poisson d'eau douce ! Il y a pire comme étang, tu ne trouves pas ?
russian: Да это же новая рыбка в пруду! Пруд хороший, правда?
bulgarian: If it isn't the new fish in the pond! This pond's nice, isn't it?

english: Thank you.
french: Mais merci.
russian: Спасибо.
bulgarian: Thank you.

english: A birthday gift? For me? You're making me feel like a fish out of water, [Ari]!
french: Un cadeau d'anniversaire, pour moi ? Je ne sais plus où me mettre, [Ari] !
russian: Подарок на день рождения? Мне? Я чувствую себя как рыба на суше, [Ari]!
bulgarian: A birthday gift? For me? You're making me feel like a fish out of water, [Ari]!

english: Don't even think I could use this as bait... ah well.
french: Pas sûre que ça pourrait servir d'appât... mais c'est l'intention qui compte.
russian: Даже не знаю, пойдёт ли это на наживку... ну да ладно.
bulgarian: Don't even think I could use this as bait... ah well.

english: There's nothing worse than pulling up some $Fiber$ at the end of your line, and you'd give it to me as gift?
french: Le pire pour un pêcheur, c'est de remonter des cochonneries au bout de sa ligne, et toi, tu m'offres de la $fibre$ ?
russian: Нет ничего хуже, чем вытащить $волокно$ на крючке, а ты мне это ещё и даришь?
bulgarian: There's nothing worse than pulling up some $Fiber$ at the end of your line, and you'd give it to me as gift?

english: KYA HA HA!
french: HÉ HÉ HÉ !
russian: КЯ-ХА-ХА!
bulgarian: KYA HA HA!

english: Oho, what a gift! What's better than fish? =Fish Stew=!
french: Oh ho, sacré cadeau ! Qu'est-ce qui est meilleur que le poisson lui-même ? La =soupe de poisson= !
russian: О-хо, вот это подарок! Что может быть лучше рыбы? Только =рыбное рагу=!
bulgarian: Oho, what a gift! What's better than fish? =Fish Stew=!

english: A gift? For me? Ain't that nice.
french: Un cadeau ? Pour moi ? C'est gentil, ça.
russian: Подарок? Мне? Как замечательно.
bulgarian: A gift? For me? Ain't that nice.

english: What handsomely prepared seafood! Thank you, [Ari].
french: Ce plat de délices de la mer semble avoir été préparé avec amour ! Merci, [Ari].
russian: Какое роскошное морское блюдо! Спасибо, [Ari].
bulgarian: What handsomely prepared seafood! Thank you, [Ari].

english: I do appreciate when someone else does the work for me! Thanks, I'll enjoy this!
french: J'adore qu'on fasse le travail à ma place ! Merci, je saurai l'apprécier.
russian: Люблю, когда кто-то другой всё готовит за меня! Спасибо, с удовольствием съем!
bulgarian: I do appreciate when someone else does the work for me! Thanks, I'll enjoy this!

english: You're as generous as the sea, [Ari]!
french: Quelle générosité, [Ari]. Comme la mer.
russian:
Ты

щедры

щедращедрщедро, как само море, [Ari]!
bulgarian: You're as generous as the sea, [Ari]!

english: You sure know how to brighten an ol' girl's day! Much thanks for your kindness, [Ari]!
french: Tu sais t'y prendre pour égayer la journée d'une vieille louve de mer comme moi ! Merci de ta gentillesse, [Ari].
russian: Ты и правда умеешь скрасить день старушке! Огромное спасибо, [Ari]!
bulgarian: You sure know how to brighten an ol' girl's day! Much thanks for your kindness, [Ari]!

english: Now this is fine fare! There's nothing better than a dish overflowing with the bounty of the sea.
french: Voilà qui a l'air délicieux ! Rien de tel qu'un bon petit plat qui regorge de toutes les saveurs de la mer.
russian: Вот это, я понимаю, еда! Нет ничего лучше блюда, полного морских даров.
bulgarian: Now this is fine fare! There's nothing better than a dish overflowing with the bounty of the sea.

english: Oho! I can catch a fish like it's nothing, but preparing 'em was never my strong suit. My thanks, [Ari]!
french: Oh ho ! Je ne suis pas la dernière pour attraper des poissons, mais les préparer, ça n'a jamais été mon fort. Merci bien, [Ari].
russian: О-хо! Поймать рыбу мне раз плюнуть, а вот готовить я никогда не умела. Спасибо, [Ari]!
bulgarian: Oho! I can catch a fish like it's nothing, but preparing 'em was never my strong suit. My thanks, [Ari]!

english: Thanks.
french: Merci.
russian: Спасибо.
bulgarian: Thanks.

english: Coffee is etched into my schedule... during long days at sea, it helped mark the start of a new day. Until we ran out, anyway.
french: Le café fait partie intégrante de moi... Pendant nos trajets au long cours, cela marquait le début de la journée. Jusqu'à ce qu'on n'en ait plus.
russian: Кофе — часть моего распорядка... в долгих морских плаваниях он всегда знаменовал начало нового дня. Ну, пока не заканчивался, конечно.
bulgarian: Coffee is etched into my schedule... during long days at sea, it helped mark the start of a new day. Until we ran out, anyway.

english: Errol had me try one of Darcy's lattes... it was delicious! I wonder if I'll be able to go back to black coffee...
french: Errol a insisté pour que je goûte au café latte de Darcy... C'est un régal. À tel point que je ne sais pas si je pourrai revenir au café noir...
russian: Эррол уговорил меня попробовать латте от Дарси... вкуснятина! Интересно, смогу ли я вернуться к чёрному кофе...
bulgarian: Errol had me try one of Darcy's lattes... it was delicious! I wonder if I'll be able to go back to black coffee...

english: Errol talked me into trying a $Mocha$ at Darcy's... I've never tasted anything like that! Sweet and bitter... like my true love, the ocean.
french: Errol m'a convaincue de prendre un mocaccino chez Darcy... Je n'avais jamais rien goûté de tel ! À la fois doux et amer... comme la mer, mon grand amour.
russian: Эррол подсадил меня на мокко от Дарси... я никогда не пробовала ничего подобного! Сладко и горько... как моя любовь — океан.
bulgarian: Errol talked me into trying a $Mocha$ at Darcy's... I've never tasted anything like that! Sweet and bitter... like my true love, the ocean.

english: Coffee and baked goods, together... Darcy's a shrewd one. I'm curious to see where her business goes.
french: Du café et des pâtisseries... Darcy a vraiment le sens des affaires. J'ai hâte de voir comment son petit commerce va évoluer.
russian: Кофе с выпечкой... Дарси знает, как вести дела. Интересно, как дальше пойдёт её бизнес.
bulgarian: Coffee and baked goods, together... Darcy's a shrewd one. I'm curious to see where her business goes.

english: Louis is more famous than he lets on. Even back in my soldiering days, I heard tell of him in foreign lands.
french: Louis est plus célèbre qu'il veut bien le faire croire. À l'époque où j'étais dans la marine, j'entendais parler de lui dans des contrées lointaines.
russian: Луи куда знаменитее, чем делает вид. Ещё в мои солдатские годы я слышала о нём за морями.
bulgarian: Louis is more famous than he lets on. Even back in my soldiering days, I heard tell of him in foreign lands.

english: Well, I'm certainly glad he's here with us! He makes the best of it!
french: Mais je suis heureuse qu'il soit parmi nous ! Il fait de son mieux !
russian: Ну, я рада, что он с нами! Он справляется на все сто!
bulgarian: Well, I'm certainly glad he's here with us! He makes the best of it!

english: Louis is always a bit like a fish out of water, wherever he goes... you can tell he'd be more at home in a royal court.
french: Où qu'il se trouve, Louis ne semble jamais à l'aise... Ça se voit qu'il n'y a qu'à la cour qu'il serait dans son élément.
russian: Луи всегда чуть не в своей тарелке... видно, что ему бы лучше подошёл королевский дворец.
bulgarian: Louis is always a bit like a fish out of water, wherever he goes... you can tell he'd be more at home in a royal court.

english: I've been able to hold onto my clothes from my soldiering days because Louis has a real knack for mending.
french: J'ai pu conserver mes habits de marine parce que Louis est un maître du rapiéçage.
russian: Мне удалось сохранить одежду со службы в хорошем виде благодаря золотым рукам Луи.
bulgarian: I've been able to hold onto my clothes from my soldiering days because Louis has a real knack for mending.

english: Sometimes I look at the clothes Louis has around his booth and think it might be nice to try something new... but I'm accustomed to the clothes of a soldier and a sailor. Still...
french: Parfois, quand je vois ce que Louis vend, je me dis que ça serait sympa de changer de style... mais je suis tellement habituée à mes vêtements de marine. Pourtant...
russian: Иногда смотрю на одежду из лавки Луи и думаю: а может, стоит попробовать что-то новенькое... но я так привыкла к солдатским да моряцким вещам. И всё же...
bulgarian: Sometimes I look at the clothes Louis has around his booth and think it might be nice to try something new... but I'm accustomed to the clothes of a soldier and a sailor. Still...

english: Most of my furniture comes from Merri... I like my things to be a little worn in.
french: La plupart de mes meubles viennent de chez Merri. J'aime bien tout ce qui est un petit peu usé.
russian: Почти вся моя мебель — от Мэрри... люблю, когда вещь немного пожившая.
bulgarian: Most of my furniture comes from Merri... I like my things to be a little worn in.

english: Merri and I have a nice arrangement going... I bring her whatever strange things I haul up from the bottom of the bay, and she gives me first pick after she's done restoring it!
french: Merri et moi, on a conclu un marché... Je lui apporte les trucs bizarres que je remonte du fond de l'eau et j'ai la priorité quand elle a fini de les restaurer !
russian: У нас с Мэрри выгодное соглашение... я приношу ей всякое, что вытаскиваю со дна залива, а она даёт мне выбирать первой после реставрации!
bulgarian: Merri and I have a nice arrangement going... I bring her whatever strange things I haul up from the bottom of the bay, and she gives me first pick after she's done restoring it!

english: Merri's got some fun things in stock today... anything that looks like it was dredged up from the bottom of the bay? That's my preference, KYA HA HA!
french: Merri a de drôles de trucs en stock, aujourd'hui... Tu vois quelque chose qui semble avoir été remonté du fond de l'eau ? Moi, c'est ce que je préfère, hé hé hé !
russian: У Мэрри сегодня интересный ассортимент... Если вижу что-то, что выглядит так, будто это подняли с какого-нибудь дна, сразу понимаю — моё. КЯ-ХА-ХА!
bulgarian: Merri's got some fun things in stock today... anything that looks like it was dredged up from the bottom of the bay? That's my preference, KYA HA HA!

english: Merri always puts the nautical bits and bobs aside for me... what a nice girl, KYA HA HA!
french: Merri me met de côté toutes les babioles qui ont rapport de près ou de loin avec la mer... C'est un amour, hé hé hé.
russian: Мэрри всегда откладывает для меня всякие морские штуковины... хорошая девочка, КЯ-ХА-ХА!
bulgarian: Merri always puts the nautical bits and bobs aside for me... what a nice girl, KYA HA HA!

english: I don't take the doom and gloom in Stillwell's fortunes too seriously... I've seen doom and gloom, and a peaceful day at the Saturday Market is the furthest from it.
bulgarian: I don't take the doom and gloom in Stillwell's fortunes too seriously... I've seen doom and gloom, and a peaceful day at the Saturday Market is the furthest from it.

english: I asked Stillwell if I'd ever catch... the Big One... and he said, "Oh warrior, if you seek the dragon, look to the skies... but beware the sun!"
bulgarian: I asked Stillwell if I'd ever catch... the Big One... and he said, "Oh warrior, if you seek the dragon, look to the skies... but beware the sun!"

english: What does that mean? I was hoping for like, lure advice. Oh well.
bulgarian: What does that mean? I was hoping for like, lure advice. Oh well.

english: Stillwell's love fortune was a little inscrutable. "Close no path to love, and all paths open. Close one path to love, and all paths close."
bulgarian: Stillwell's love fortune was a little inscrutable. "Close no path to love, and all paths open. Close one path to love, and all paths close."

english: That's a little over my head... I'll stick to my true love, the Sea.
bulgarian: That's a little over my head... I'll stick to my true love, the Sea.

english: My love fortune was a little different today... Stillwell said, "your greatest foe lies at the heart of your greatest love", and then he dissolved into moaning.
bulgarian: My love fortune was a little different today... Stillwell said, "your greatest foe lies at the heart of your greatest love", and then he dissolved into moaning.

english: I suppose the Big One hides in the sea... is that what he means?
bulgarian: I suppose the Big One hides in the sea... is that what he means?

english: A month at sea as a ship's cook would straighten him out!
french: S'il passait un mois en tant que chef-coq sur un bateau, ça le remettrait à sa place !
russian: Месяц в море в качестве кока его бы точно исправил!
bulgarian: A month at sea as a ship's cook would straighten him out!

english: Either that or he'd die. Tough to say.
french: Ou alors, il n'y survivrait pas. Difficile à dire.
russian: А может, он бы не выжил. Сложно сказать.
bulgarian: Either that or he'd die. Tough to say.

english: That Taliferro has a bit of a mouth on him...
french: Ce Taliferro n'a pas sa langue dans sa poche...
russian: Этот Талиферро остёр на язык...
bulgarian: That Taliferro has a bit of a mouth on him...

english: It's more like art. And I don't want to eat art!
french: C'est une œuvre d'art et ça me coupe l'appétit !
russian: Это, скорее, искусство. А искусство я есть не хочу!
bulgarian: It's more like art. And I don't want to eat art!

english: I'm trying to explain to Taliferro, there's a point at which food gets so fancy that it's not really food anymore...
french: J'essaie d'expliquer à Taliferro qu'il y a un moment où un plat devient si sophistiqué que ça n'est plus vraiment de la nourriture...
russian: Я пыталась объяснить Талиферро, что в какой-то момент еда становится такой затейливой, что это уже и не еда...
bulgarian: I'm trying to explain to Taliferro, there's a point at which food gets so fancy that it's not really food anymore...

english: Until you gotta talk to him, anyway.
french: Enfin, jusqu'au moment où tu discutes avec lui.
russian: По крайней мере, пока не приходится с ним разговаривать.
bulgarian: Until you gotta talk to him, anyway.

english: Are you going to enter Taliferro's $Cooking Challenge$? It's heaps of fun!
french: Tu comptes participer au $défi gastronomique$ de Taliferro ? C'est super amusant.
russian: Будешь принимать участие в $смотре блюд$ Талиферро? Это ужасно весело!
bulgarian: Are you going to enter Taliferro's $Cooking Challenge$? It's heaps of fun!

english: Hard to imagine him outside a fancy kitchen, if I'm being honest.
french: À vrai dire, je ne l'imagine pas ailleurs que dans une belle cuisine bien équipée.
russian: Если честно, его вообще трудно представить где-то, кроме модной кухни.
bulgarian: Hard to imagine him outside a fancy kitchen, if I'm being honest.

english: Guess that's why he brings one with him wherever he goes... like a posh little hermit crab!
french: C'est sûrement pour ça qu'il l'emporte partout avec lui... Un vrai bernard-l'ermite aux goûts de luxe.
russian: Видимо, поэтому он всюду таскает её с собой... будто напыщенный рачок-отшельник!
bulgarian: Guess that's why he brings one with him wherever he goes... like a posh little hermit crab!

english: KYA HA HA!
french: HÉ HÉ HÉ !
russian: КЯ-ХА-ХА!
bulgarian: KYA HA HA!

english: I wonder if Taliferro can fish? It's hard to imagine him throwing a line.
french: Je me demande si Taliferro sait pêcher. Je ne le vois pas avec une canne à la main.
russian: Интересно, Талиферро умеет рыбачить? Не могу представить, чтобы он закидывал удочку.
bulgarian: I wonder if Taliferro can fish? It's hard to imagine him throwing a line.

english: Vera says she can dye my hair blue... might be nice.
french: Vera m'a dit qu'elle pourrait me faire une teinture bleue... Pourquoi pas ?
russian: Вера говорит, может покрасить мне волосы в синий... было бы недурно.
bulgarian: Vera says she can dye my hair blue... might be nice.

english: I might dye my hair just to startle the boys... Landen and Errol won't expect it.
french: Je me ferais bien teindre les cheveux, pour surprendre les gars... Landen et Errol feraient une de ces têtes.
russian: Может, и покрашусь, чтобы шокировать парней... Ланден с Эрролом не ожидают такого!
bulgarian: I might dye my hair just to startle the boys... Landen and Errol won't expect it.

english: When I was a younger thing I used to keep my hair real short. It's been nice to grow it out and have Vera fuss over it!
french: Plus jeune, je coupais mes cheveux très courts. Mais maintenant, je préfère les avoir longs pour laisser Vera s'en donner à cœur joie !
russian: Когда я была моложе, носила совсем короткие волосы. А сейчас приятно отрастить и дать Вере поухаживать!
bulgarian: When I was a younger thing I used to keep my hair real short. It's been nice to grow it out and have Vera fuss over it!

english: Vera suggested I dye my hair a seaweed green... now that would be a sight!
french: Vera m'a suggéré de me teindre les cheveux vert algue. Ça, ça vaudrait le détour !
russian: Вера предложила покрасить волосы в цвет морской водоросли... Вот это был бы видок!
bulgarian: Vera suggested I dye my hair a seaweed green... now that would be a sight!

english: I'd wager the only thing I could use it for is greasing hinges!
french: Au mieux, ça me servirait à graisser les gonds de mes portes !
russian: Разве что петли смазывать!
bulgarian: I'd wager the only thing I could use it for is greasing hinges!

english: Kya ha ha!
french: Hé hé hé !
russian: Кя-ха-ха!
bulgarian: Kya ha ha!

english: Don't know that Wheedle's Snake Oils have any use to me.
french: Je ne vois pas ce que je pourrais faire de l'huile de couleuvre de Wheedle.
russian: Думаю, змеиные масла Хлюста мне совершенно ни к чему.
bulgarian: Don't know that Wheedle's Snake Oils have any use to me.

english: Why would I pay for something I fish up twice a week for free!
french: Pourquoi je paierais pour un truc que je remonte une à deux fois par semaine dans mes filets ?
russian: Я такие вылавливаю бесплатно пару раз в неделю — с чего бы мне ещё за них платить?
bulgarian: Why would I pay for something I fish up twice a week for free!

english: That Wheedle tried to sell me an old barnacle-encrusted treasure chest for a ridiculous price.
french: Wheedle a voulu me refourguer un vieux coffre au trésor tapissé de berniques au prix fort.
russian: Этот Хлюст хотел мне продать старинный сундук, покрытый раковинами, за какую-то невероятную цену.
bulgarian: That Wheedle tried to sell me an old barnacle-encrusted treasure chest for a ridiculous price.

english: Nice paint job, though. Maybe that fella missed his calling as an artist!
french: La peinture était nickel, d'ailleurs. Ce type a peut-être raté sa vocation d'artiste !
russian: Но покрас качественный. Быть может, у него в душе погибает художник!
bulgarian: Nice paint job, though. Maybe that fella missed his calling as an artist!

english: Wheedle tried to sell me a fishing rod made out of Gulliblethril, but it was just a piece of driftwood he painted pink.
french: Wheedle a tenté de me refourguer une canne à pêche en ânuminium. En fait, c'était un morceau de bois flotté qu'il avait peint en rose.
russian: Хлюст хотел продать мне удочку из простофилла, но это оказался просто кусок коряги, перекрашенный в розовый.
bulgarian: Wheedle tried to sell me a fishing rod made out of Gulliblethril, but it was just a piece of driftwood he painted pink.

english: Couldn't trust the man to shake your hand without stealing your rings...
french: Après lui avoir serré la main, tu vérifiais si tu avais encore toutes tes bagues.
russian: Пожмёшь ему руку — останешься без кольца...
bulgarian: Couldn't trust the man to shake your hand without stealing your rings...

english: But he sure kept things interesting!
french: Au moins, il mettait de l'ambiance à bord !
russian: Но зато с ним было интересно!
bulgarian: But he sure kept things interesting!

english: Used to know a fellow like Wheedle back when I was soldiering. He ran the ship's commissary.
french: Quand j'étais dans la marine, j'ai connu un type qui me rappelle Wheedle. Il tenait la cambuse.
russian: Когда я была на службе, знала я одного парня вроде Хлюста. Он заведовал корабельным буфетом.
bulgarian: Used to know a fellow like Wheedle back when I was soldiering. He ran the ship's commissary.

english: Ahh, it really took me back.
french: Aaah, ça m'a rappelé de bons souvenirs.
russian: Ах, сразу воспоминания нахлынули!
bulgarian: Ahh, it really took me back.

english: Zorel was really interested to hear all the sea shanties I know!
french: Zorel avait très envie d'entendre tous les chants de marins que je connais !
russian: Зорель очень интересовалась песнями моряков. А я их много знаю!
bulgarian: Zorel was really interested to hear all the sea shanties I know!

english: Good to see it relegated to the Museum, I say.
french: Tu as bien fait de l'offrir au musée. C'est là qu'est sa place.
russian: В музее ему самое место, это точно.
bulgarian: Good to see it relegated to the Museum, I say.

english: Amazing that you found that $Aldarian War Banner$. Saw the old thing while Errol was putting it out.
french: C'est incroyable que tu aies trouvé ce vieil $étendard aldarien$. Je l'ai vu quand Errol l'a sorti.
russian:
Удивительно, что ты

нашли

нашланашёлнашло $альдарийское боевое знамя$. Видела его, когда Эррол выставлял.
bulgarian: Amazing that you found that $Aldarian War Banner$. Saw the old thing while Errol was putting it out.

english: The Gar's scales are tough enough to be arrowheads. That was how I survived until rescue came. Been fond of the Alligator Gar ever since.
french: Ses écailles sont si dures qu'on peut en faire des pointes de flèche. C'est comme ça que j'ai survécu jusqu'à l'arrivée des secours. Depuis, j'adore cette espèce.
russian: У него чешуя жёсткая, самое то для наконечников стрел. Только поэтому я и продержалась, пока не прибыла помощь. С тех пор очень люблю этих рыб.
bulgarian: The Gar's scales are tough enough to be arrowheads. That was how I survived until rescue came. Been fond of the Alligator Gar ever since.

english: The $Alligator Gar$ at the Museum had me thinking back to my time on a deserted island.
french: Le $garpique alligator$ du musée m'a rappelé la fois où je m'étais échouée sur une île déserte.
russian: $Панцирник$ в музее напомнил мне время, когда я жила на необитаемом острове.
bulgarian: The $Alligator Gar$ at the Museum had me thinking back to my time on a deserted island.

english: An eel's an eel, after all.
french: En même temps, ça reste des anguilles.
russian: Угорь есть угорь.
bulgarian: An eel's an eel, after all.

english: I was admiring that $Cave Eel$ you hauled over to the Museum. They're blind, but they're still pretty tricky to catch!
french: L'autre jour, j'admirais l'$anguille troglodyte$ que tu as donnée au musée. Elles ont beau être aveugles, elles ne se laissent pas attraper si facilement !
russian:
Я любовалась $пещерным угрём$, которого ты

принесли

принеслапринёспринесло в музей. Они хоть и слепые, но поймать такого — та ещё задачка!
bulgarian: I was admiring that $Cave Eel$ you hauled over to the Museum. They're blind, but they're still pretty tricky to catch!

english: You've done this fisherwoman a boon, letting me see it with my own eyes!
french: Crois-moi si je te dis combien ça m'a fait plaisir que tu me permettes d'en voir un en vrai !
russian: [Ari], рыбачке увидеть её своими глазами — это подарок для меня.
bulgarian: You've done this fisherwoman a boon, letting me see it with my own eyes!

english: I'd heard stories of the $Cherry Fish$, but I never knew what it looked like until I saw it at the Museum. So little, so beautiful, so pink!
french: On m'avait déjà parlé du $poisson-cerise$, mais je n'en avais encore jamais vu. Il est tout petit, tout mignon et tout rose !
russian: Я слышала истории о $вишнёвом барбусе$, но не знала, как она выглядит, пока не увидела в музее. Такая крошечная, такая красивая, такая розовая!
bulgarian: I'd heard stories of the $Cherry Fish$, but I never knew what it looked like until I saw it at the Museum. So little, so beautiful, so pink!

english: If age gets you in, then maybe Eiland should add me to the collection, too! Oh, but then he'd have to add Errol and Landen too...
french: Si c'est l'âge qui t'intéresse, peut-être qu'Eiland devrait m'ajouter moi aussi à la collection ! Oh, mais il devrait alors rajouter Errol et Landen, aussi...
russian: Раз тут дело в возрасте, так, может, Эйланд и меня добавит в коллекцию! Ох, тогда и Эррола с Ланденом придётся загрести...
bulgarian: If age gets you in, then maybe Eiland should add me to the collection, too! Oh, but then he'd have to add Errol and Landen too...

english: KYA HA HA!
french: HÉ HÉ HÉ !
russian: КЯ-ХА-ХА!
bulgarian: KYA HA HA!

english: That $Coelacanth$ in the Museum's aquatic collection... it's not often you see a fish so ancient.
french: Ce $cœlacanthe$, dans la collection aquatique du musée... Ce n'est pas souvent qu'on voit un poisson aussi vieux.
russian: Я видела в подводном отделе музея $целаканта$... Нечасто доводится посмотреть на столь древнюю рыбу.
bulgarian: That $Coelacanth$ in the Museum's aquatic collection... it's not often you see a fish so ancient.

english: I'm just wondering what a prehistoric scramble tastes like.
french: J'aimerais savoir quel goût ça a, une omelette préhistorique.
russian: Просто хочется узнать, какова доисторическая яичница на вкус.
bulgarian: I'm just wondering what a prehistoric scramble tastes like.

english: That $Fossilized Egg$ you found. Would Errol be cross if I ate it?
french: Tu crois qu'Errol m'en voudrait si je mangeais cet $œuf fossilisé$ que tu as trouvé ?
russian:
Это ты

нашли

нашланашёлнашло $окаменелое яйцо$. Интересно, Эррол сильно рассердится, если я его съем?
bulgarian: That $Fossilized Egg$ you found. Would Errol be cross if I ate it?

english: It took a hundred long years to reach the top, and in recognition of the feat, the koi was blessed and turned into a dragon!
french: Il lui a fallu un siècle entier pour y parvenir, et en récompense de cet exploit, la carpe koï a été changée en dragon !
russian: Сто лет взбирался — и за упорство был превращён в дракона!
bulgarian: It took a hundred long years to reach the top, and in recognition of the feat, the koi was blessed and turned into a dragon!

english: I wouldn't go around asking any dragons if they were formerly fish, though.
french: Évidemment, je n'irais pas demander à un dragon s'il était un poisson autrefois.
russian: Но я бы не советовала напрямую спрашивать у дракона, был ли он раньше рыбой.
bulgarian: I wouldn't go around asking any dragons if they were formerly fish, though.

english: It's a funny feeling, seeing a $Giant Koi$ immortalized at the Museum like that. Brings to mind an old story about the koi who leapt up a waterfall.
french: C'est drôle de voir une $carpe koï géante$ présentée au musée. Ça m'a fait repenser à la légende de celle qui avait remonté une cascade.
russian: Странное чувство — видеть $большого кои$ в музее. Вспомнилась старая история о кои, что прыгал вверх по водопаду.
bulgarian: It's a funny feeling, seeing a $Giant Koi$ immortalized at the Museum like that. Brings to mind an old story about the koi who leapt up a waterfall.

english: My my, that was a large one. You've got guts!
french: Eh bien, c'est une belle prise ! Tu as du cran.
russian: Ничего себе, здоровый! Храбрости тебе не занимать!
bulgarian: My my, that was a large one. You've got guts!

english: [Ari]! That $Grouper$ that Errol's got on display, that was your catch?
french: [Ari] ! Ce $mérou$ qu'Errol expose au musée, c'est toi qui l'as attrapé ?
russian: [Ari]! Тот $групер$ в музее — твой улов?
bulgarian: [Ari]! That $Grouper$ that Errol's got on display, that was your catch?

english: I've heard that they're cousins with the Cod, but I don't see much family resemblance!
french: Il paraît que c'est un cousin du cabillaud, mais je ne leur trouve pas d'air de famille !
russian: Я слышала, что он родственник трески, но с виду они совсем не похожи!
bulgarian: I've heard that they're cousins with the Cod, but I don't see much family resemblance!

english: Did you catch that $Hake$ at the Museum, [Ari]? A fine job.
french: C'est toi qui as attrapé ce $merlu$ qu'on voit au musée, [Ari] ? Beau travail.
russian:
Это ты

поймали

поймалапоймалпоймало $хека$ для музея, [Ari]? Отличная работа.
bulgarian: Did you catch that $Hake$ at the Museum, [Ari]? A fine job.

english: I wonder what it is about the Deep Woods that makes that trout different than the ones in the river?
french: Qu'est-ce qu'il peut y avoir à Boissombre qui rend les truites si différentes de celles de la rivière ?
russian: Интересно: чего в Глубокой чаще такого особенного, что рыбы там отличаются от речных?
bulgarian: I wonder what it is about the Deep Woods that makes that trout different than the ones in the river?

english: Maybe it's something in the water!
french: C'est peut-être quelque chose dans l'eau ?
russian: Может, какая-то необычная вода!
bulgarian: Maybe it's something in the water!

english: That $Lake Trout$ at the Museum got me thinking...
french: En voyant cette $truite de lac$ au musée, ça m'a fait penser...
russian: Я рассматривала $озёрного гольца$ в музее и задумалась...
bulgarian: That $Lake Trout$ at the Museum got me thinking...

english: And to think, it was in Mistria this whole time! It's a good feeling, knowing there's still new critters to catch!
french: Dire qu'il était à Mistria depuis tout ce temps ! Ça fait plaisir de savoir qu'il reste encore de nouvelles espèces à découvrir !
russian: И подумать только: всё это время они водились в Мистрии! Приятно знать, что ещё есть, кого ловить!
bulgarian: And to think, it was in Mistria this whole time! It's a good feeling, knowing there's still new critters to catch!

english: I'd only heard tales of the $Leaf Fish$ until I saw it at the Museum, [Ari]. Where'd you find such a legend?
french: Je ne connaissais le $poisson-feuille$ que de nom quand j'ai vu celui du musée, [Ari]. Où as-tu trouvé ce spécimen unique ?
russian:
О $рыбе-листе$ я только слышала, пока не увидела её в музее, [Ari]. Где ты её

нашли

нашланашёлнашло?
bulgarian: I'd only heard tales of the $Leaf Fish$ until I saw it at the Museum, [Ari]. Where'd you find such a legend?

english: So you're storm fishing, eh, [Ari]? I won't stop you, but keep on your toes!
french: Tu pêches par gros temps, [Ari] ? Je ne vais pas t'en empêcher, mais fais attention à toi quand même !
russian: Значит, ты ловишь во время шторма, [Ari]? Ну, отговаривать я тебя не буду, но будь осторожнее!
bulgarian: So you're storm fishing, eh, [Ari]? I won't stop you, but keep on your toes!

english: A $Lightning Fish$! At the Museum! My old commander said you can only catch them in the middle of a summer storm.
french: Un $poisson-éclair$ ! Au musée ! Le capitaine pour qui je travaillais autrefois m'avait dit qu'on ne pouvait en pêcher que lors d'un orage d'été.
russian: $Рыба-молния$! В музее! Мой старый капитан говорил, что такую можно поймать только во время летней грозы.
bulgarian: A $Lightning Fish$! At the Museum! My old commander said you can only catch them in the middle of a summer storm.

english: A puffed up minnow is still a minnow, after all!
french: Parce qu'un méné imbu de lui-même, ça reste quand même un méné !
russian: Надутый пескарь — всё равно пескарь!
bulgarian: A puffed up minnow is still a minnow, after all!

english: That $Massive Minnow$ that Eiland's got over at the Museum... that fish is a bit of a joke among us fisherfolk.
french: Ce $méné imposant$ qu'Eiland a fait entrer au musée... C'est un sujet de plaisanterie, entre pêcheurs.
russian: $Пескарь-гигант$, что лежит у Эйланда в музее... У нас, рыбаков, про него часто шутят.
bulgarian: That $Massive Minnow$ that Eiland's got over at the Museum... that fish is a bit of a joke among us fisherfolk.

english: I wonder if they're as tasty as the regular kind?
french: Je me demande si elles ont le même goût que les moules ordinaires...
russian: Интересно, они такие же вкусные, как обычные?
bulgarian: I wonder if they're as tasty as the regular kind?

english: Errol's got those little $Mines Mussels$ on display at the Museum.
french: Errol a monté une petite expo avec des $moules des mines$ au musée.
russian: Эррол выставил $шахтенных мидий$ в музее.
bulgarian: Errol's got those little $Mines Mussels$ on display at the Museum.

english: The Mini-Whale Shark is still pretty big, though.
french: Enfin, il reste quand même imposant.
russian: Хотя и «крошечная», а всё равно довольно большая.
bulgarian: The Mini-Whale Shark is still pretty big, though.

english: That $Mini-Whale Shark$ at the Museum sure is cute! Well, compared to a regular-size whale shark.
french: Le $mini requin-baleine$ du musée est Trop mignon ! Surtout si on le compare à son cousin normal.
russian: $Крошечная китовая акула$ в музее — такая милашка! Ну, по сравнению с обычной китовой акулой.
bulgarian: That $Mini-Whale Shark$ at the Museum sure is cute! Well, compared to a regular-size whale shark.

english: They used to say the paddle was for digging, but it's not the case! A sea scholar told me that.
french: Avant, on pensait que sa spatule servait à creuser, mais ce n'est pas le cas ! Je tiens ça d'un océanologue.
russian: Говорили раньше, что весло у неё для копания. Ан нет! Один морской учёный объяснил мне.
bulgarian: They used to say the paddle was for digging, but it's not the case! A sea scholar told me that.

english: I spied a $Paddlefish$ at the Museum and figured that was your doing. What a funny-looking creature.
french: J'ai vu un $poisson-spatule$ au musée. Je me suis doutée que c'était toi qui l'avais trouvé. Quelle drôle de créature !
russian: Увидела в музее $веслоноса$ и сразу поняла — твоих рук дело. Странное создание.
bulgarian: I spied a $Paddlefish$ at the Museum and figured that was your doing. What a funny-looking creature.

english: It's a big wide world, ain't it!
french: Le monde recèle bien des secrets !
russian: Мир большой, это уж точно!
bulgarian: It's a big wide world, ain't it!

english: I've never seen a fish like that $Pebble Minnow$ at the Museum. It came from a cave deep beneath the earth?
french: Je n'ai jamais vu aucun poisson comme ce $méné galet$ au musée. Il vient du fin fond d'une grotte ?
russian: Никогда не видела рыбу, как этот $гальковый пескарь$ в музее. Он из пещеры, что глубоко под землёй?
bulgarian: I've never seen a fish like that $Pebble Minnow$ at the Museum. It came from a cave deep beneath the earth?

english: There's a $Rock Guppy$ at the Museum, was that your doing? I'm impressed! Most folks can't tell the difference between a Rock Guppy and the regular kind.
french: Il y a un $guppy de rocaille$ au musée. C'est toi qui l'as trouvé ? Très impressionnant ! La plupart des gens ne savent pas faire la différence entre un guppy de rocaille et un guppy normal, tu sais.
russian: В музее есть $каменный гуппи$, это тоже твоя работа? Уважаю! Большинство людей не отличат его от обычного.
bulgarian: There's a $Rock Guppy$ at the Museum, was that your doing? I'm impressed! Most folks can't tell the difference between a Rock Guppy and the regular kind.

english: That coat of arms isn't familiar to me, though. I suppose it's a big wide world, eh [Ari]?
french: Les armoiries ne me disent rien... mais le monde est grand, pas vrai, [Ari] ?
russian: А герб на нём мне не знаком... Мир велик, что тут скажешь. Да, [Ari]?
bulgarian: That coat of arms isn't familiar to me, though. I suppose it's a big wide world, eh [Ari]?

english: That $Rusted Shield$ in the Sunken Antiquities area of the Museum brings back memories.
french: Ce $bouclier rouillé$ exposé dans l'aile des antiquités englouties du musée fait remonter des souvenirs.
russian: Этот $ржавый щит$ в зале Затонувших древностей навеял воспоминания.
bulgarian: That $Rusted Shield$ in the Sunken Antiquities area of the Museum brings back memories.

english: The $Shadow Bass$ doesn't always live up to such an imposing name, but you certainly caught a fine specimen for the Museum!
french: L'$ambloplite$ n'a pas un nom très courant, mais tu en as trouvé un magnifique spécimen pour le musée !
russian:
Не каждый $тёмный окунь$ оправдывает своё грозное имя, но ты

поймали

поймалапоймалпоймало отличный экземпляр для музея!
bulgarian: The $Shadow Bass$ doesn't always live up to such an imposing name, but you certainly caught a fine specimen for the Museum!

english: You're brave to reel that one in! And strong to boot.
french: Il 't'a fallu du courage et de la force pour le pêcher !
russian: Чтобы такую поймать, нужна не только отвага, но и силушка.
bulgarian: You're brave to reel that one in! And strong to boot.

english: My eyes about jumped out of my head when I saw that $Shark$ you caught at the Museum.
french: Je n'en ai pas cru mes yeux quand j'ai vu le $requin$ que tu as offert au musée.
russian:
У меня глаза чуть не выскочили, когда я увидела в музее $акулу$, которую ты

поймали

поймалапоймалпоймало.
bulgarian: My eyes about jumped out of my head when I saw that $Shark$ you caught at the Museum.

english: Now THAT is something. Sounds like I've got a new winter goal! KYA HA HA!
french: Eh bien... Je crois que je me suis trouvé un nouvel objectif pour l'hiver prochain ! Hé hé hé !
russian: Вот это да! Похоже, у меня новая зимняя цель! КЯ-ХА-ХА!
bulgarian: Now THAT is something. Sounds like I've got a new winter goal! KYA HA HA!

english: There's a $Snow Fish$ at the Museum, [Ari]! You caught the real thing? Here in Mistria?
french: J'ai vu un $poisson des neiges$ au musée, [Ari] ! Tu as vraiment réussi à en attraper un ici, à Mistria ?
russian:
В музее есть $снежная рыба$, [Ari]! Это ты её

поймали

поймалапоймалпоймало? Прямо здесь, в Мистрии?
bulgarian: There's a $Snow Fish$ at the Museum, [Ari]! You caught the real thing? Here in Mistria?

english: Because it's so flashy! And round, of course.
french: Parce qu'il est très brillant ! Et tout rond, bien évidemment.
russian: Потому что она такая яркая! И, конечно, потому что круглая.
bulgarian: Because it's so flashy! And round, of course.

english: You know why they call that fish at the Museum a $Sunny$?
french: Tu sais pourquoi ce poisson, au musée, s'appelle le $crapet-soleil$ ?
russian: Знаешь, почему музейная рыбка $солнечник$ так называется?
bulgarian: You know why they call that fish at the Museum a $Sunny$?

english: Thinking of having a little slice of ocean in my home warms the cockles of my heart!
french: L'idée qu'il soit possible d'avoir un petit bout d'océan dans son salon me réchauffe le cœur !
russian: Подумала, а не устроить ли себе уголок океана прямо дома. Согревает душу!
bulgarian: Thinking of having a little slice of ocean in my home warms the cockles of my heart!

english: That $Tidestone$ at the Museum bewitched me, [Ari].
french: La $pierre des marées$ exposée au musée m'a envoûtée, [Ari].
russian: $Камень приливов$ в музее прямо заколдовал меня, [Ari].
bulgarian: That $Tidestone$ at the Museum bewitched me, [Ari].

english: I used to see those everywhere, sailing along the coast of... where was it, now?
french: J'en voyais plein dans le temps. Surtout au large de... Mince, c'était où déjà ?
russian: Раньше их повсюду можно было встретить, когда я вдоль побережья плавала... или это было где-то ещё?..
bulgarian: I used to see those everywhere, sailing along the coast of... where was it, now?

english: That $Trilobite Fossil$ at the Museum takes me back!
french: Le $fossile de trilobite$ du musée fait remonter des souvenirs en moi !
russian: Музейный $окаменелый трилобит$ возвращает меня в прошлое!
bulgarian: That $Trilobite Fossil$ at the Museum takes me back!

english: Less of that briny kick!
french: Son goût est moins iodé !
russian: Без этого солоноватого привкуса!
bulgarian: Less of that briny kick!

english: Did you take a bite out of that $Underseaweed$ before you turned it over to Errol? It's got a milder taste than your average seaweed.
french: As-tu goûté le $varech sous-marin$ avant de le donner à Errol ? Il est plus doux que les autres algues.
russian:
Попробовали

ПопробовалаПопробовалПопробовало те $подводоросли$ на вкус, прежде чем отдать Эрролу? У них вкус мягче, чем у обычных водорослей.
bulgarian: Did you take a bite out of that $Underseaweed$ before you turned it over to Errol? It's got a milder taste than your average seaweed.

english: Do you think there's a Void Oyster out there somewhere, too?
french: Tu crois qu'il existe aussi, quelque part, une huître du néant, aussi ?
russian: Значит, и устрица где-то водится?
bulgarian: Do you think there's a Void Oyster out there somewhere, too?

english: I saw that $Void Pearl$ over at the Museum...
french: J'ai vu cette $perle du néant$, là-bas, au musée...
russian: Я видела в музее $жемчужину пустоты$...
bulgarian: I saw that $Void Pearl$ over at the Museum...

english: It's good you registered it with the Museum, though. Better to have a record of everything, nuisances included.
french: C'est une bonne chose que tu en aies fait don au musée, car il faut répertorier toutes les espèces, bonnes ou mauvaises.
russian:
Но хорошо, что ты

зарегистрировали

зарегистрировалазарегистрировалзарегистрировало его в музее. Всё должно быть под учётом, даже неприятности.
bulgarian: It's good you registered it with the Museum, though. Better to have a record of everything, nuisances included.

english: $White Perch$ is a bit of a nuisance as fish go! They eat up the eggs of other fish.
french: La $perche blanche$ est une espèce nuisible pour les autres poissons, car elle se nourrit de leurs œufs !
russian: $Белый лаврак$ — та ещё заноза. Эти едят икру других рыб.
bulgarian: $White Perch$ is a bit of a nuisance as fish go! They eat up the eggs of other fish.
